notes.title: Major updates & 4 new Winter Holiday levels!
notes.content:
[b]New updates on RoboHeist (December 2018)![/b]

[b]- 4 brand new WINTER HOLIDAY SPECIAL levels![/b] Eat all the Ginger bread cookies before the robots find and kill you!

[b]- Lots of lighting improvements on levels![/b] We have added more lights and adjusted brightness etc. on all the levels.

- Updates on graphics and other improvements!

- Fixed bugs on Leaderboards!
